newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanian boy in critical condition after attack.
newsitem.headline: Albanian boy in critical condition after attack.

text.p: A six-year-old Albanian boy was on a life support system in hospital with a bullet in his brain on Thursday after gunmen sprayed a bus with gunfire near the capital, a doctor at the hospital said.
Hospital sources said earlier the boy, wounded in an attack on Wednesday, had died. One person was killed instantly in the attack and seven, including the boy, were wounded.
"He is being kept alive with life support systems. He has a bullet lodged in his brain. It is no longer up to medicine, it is up to God," a doctor in the intensive care unit said.
The gunmen fled and the motive for the attack is unknown.
